Job Description Are you an experienced Field Service Engineer who enjoys traveling, solving technical challenges, and working on advanced industrial machinery? Do you want to be part of an international organization where no two projects are the same? Then this opportunity could be the perfect fit. As a Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of high-end process equipment and complete production systems at customer sites around the world. You will act as the technical representative on-site, ensuring installations are delivered safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with Engineering, Project Management, and Service teams, you will play a key role throughout the entire project lifecycle while building strong relationships with customers worldwide. Your responsibilities Install and commission industrial machinery and complete production lines at customer sites. Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs. Diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and control system faults. Test, optimize, and fine-tune equipment to ensure optimal performance. Train and support operators and maintenance teams. Prepare service reports and provide technical recommendations for improvements. Collaborate with Engineering and Project Management to successfully complete projects. Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety and quality standards. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. Attractive international travel and daily allowances. Annual bonus scheme. 27 vacation days plus 13 additional ADV (reduction of working hours) days. Excellent pension scheme. Company laptop, mobile phone, and professional tools. Extensive training and careerdevelopment opportunities. The opportunity to work on challenging international projects. A high level of independence and responsibility. Functie-eisen We are looking for a hands-on engineer with a passion for technology and international travel. A willingness to travel internationally on a regular basis. A valid driver's license (Category B). A customer-focused and independent working attitude. Innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are deeply embedded in the company culture, creating an environment where employees are encouraged to develop both professionally and personally.

jobs.description: Work on the engineering of custom-built superyachts Are you a Naval Architect or Marine Engineer based in Portugal and ready to take the next step in your international career? Xelvin is looking for a technically strong Naval Architect who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and work on high-end custom-built superyachts. In this role, you will contribute to the technical design and engineering of complex yacht projects. You will work on the translation of design concepts, client requirements and classification rules into technically feasible, safe and buildable solutions. This is a role for someone who understands ship design, structure, systems integration and the balance between aesthetics, performance, safety and manufacturability. What you will do As a Naval Architect, you will be involved in the engineering of luxury yachts from concept and basic engineering through detailed engineering and production support. Your responsibilities may include: Developing and checking technical ship design and engineering solutions. Working on hull design, general arrangements, layouts and technical integration. Supporting stability, weight control, structural design and construction-related calculations. Translating design concepts into technically feasible and buildable solutions. Preparing, reviewing and improving technical drawings, calculations and documentation. Coordinating with engineering teams, production, suppliers, classification societies and project stakeholders. Supporting the integration of systems, equipment, interiors and exterior elements into the overall yacht design. Identifying technical risks and proposing practical solutions. Ensuring that designs meet quality, safety, classification and production requirements. Supporting production teams during construction and resolving technical questions. Depending on your experience, the role can be more focused on basic engineering, detailed engineering, structural engineering, outfitting or technicalcoordination. What Xelvin offers you Relocating to another country is a big step. Xelvin supports you throughout the full process, from the first interview to your first working day in the Netherlands. We offer: A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,800 and €5,800, depending on experience and technical background. Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant in finding accommodation. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the relocation process. A career opportunity in one of the most respected yacht-building regions in the world. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for candidates with a background in naval architecture, marine engineering, shipbuilding or complex mechanical engineering. You have: A technical degree such as Licenciatura or Mestrado in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Shipbuilding or a related field. Experience in shipbuilding, yacht building, marine engineering, offshore, naval design or complex technical engineering. Good understanding of ship design, construction principles and technical integration. Experience with 2D and/or 3D engineering software.
